body:
What

A look over everything built so far for slow spots and things that can break, before the polish phase.

Findings
  • Search slows down past about 2,000 recipes: fixed in the polish phase.
  • A crash while saving a week can leave a half-written file: fixed in the polish phase.
  • Leftover ingredients are thrown away when a week ends. Planned as {{F:leftovers}}, Leftovers.
  • A store with no sections falls back to one long list. Left as is; dealt with if anyone asks ({{F:leftovers}}.2 would cover part of it).
name: Health Check
